correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the inclusive graph-vertex distance-two taxonomy for S(G): originals adjacent iff original edge; original-to-midpoint only if incident; midpoints adjacent iff original edges meet. All flag simplices lie in Cl(G), incident-midpoint simplices C_v, edge triangles D_e, or exceptional three-midpoint triangles T_{uvw}, because a pairwise-intersecting family of graph edges is a star or exactly a triangle. In the core A omitting only interiors of T, descending-dimensional free-face pairs (incident midpoint subsets, with/without p_v), followed by two edge-triangle pairs per edge, simplicially collapse A to Cl(G), including arbitrary degree and triangles. Each T boundary slides through C_v and D_e to its original filled graph triangle in Cl(G), hence is nullhomotopic in A; independent 2-cell attachments give Cl(G) wedge t(G) 2-spheres. H1 scale-one map is the graph-to-flag map and its kernel is generated by triangle-cycle boundaries. Independently verified the face taxonomy on all labeled simple graphs up to four vertices and inspected exact original verify.py; finite tests are supporting not the all-graph proof.
